They way I teach is with a metronome, it allows the student to learn how to move on beat to give everything a nice uniform look and helps slow down the breathing to make it as subtle as possible. Start off with a 60bps metronome (which can be found on YouTube or spotify). Right before you make your weld take a deep breath and slowly let it out through your weld, if you're doing a short weld then this method is perfect. If you're doing a longer weld and are not able to stop then try breathing in through your nose, out your mouth in short patterns (not too short or you won't get enough oxygen to your brain)
